request: Complete academy/admin development with cross-feature testing and AWS deployment
title: Block expired pass practice registration and extend cross tests
purpose: Keep practice enrollment consistent with paid learning access and verify additional platform flows

files.purpose: Reject practice registration without a valid paid/pass enrollment.
files.previous_behavior: Presence of an enrollment row allowed paid practice registration even after its pass expired.
files.new_behavior: Existing enrollment must pass the same enrollmentActive check used by learning progress; expired pass access returns 403 while active and renewed passes work.
files.data_impact: Reads enrollment source and active subscriptions before registration; rejected requests write no registration. No schema change.
files.access_control_impact: Expired pass holders cannot reserve paid practice seats; existing free, purchased and institution enrollment rules remain unchanged.
risks: Adds a paid-enrollment source/subscription lookup to practice registration.
Previously reserved seats are preserved; this patch checks new requests and does not revoke existing reservations.
files.rollback: Revert this commit and rebuild academy. No database rollback needed; reverting reopens the expired-pass access flaw.

files.purpose: Exercise additional practice, engagement, pathway, credential and pass lifecycle flows over actual authenticated HTTP.
files.previous_behavior: The suite covered 31 flows and did not detect expired-pass practice access.
files.new_behavior: 54 authenticated cross-feature checks now cover capacity races, cancellation ownership, engagement, pathway goals, credential duplicates and active/expired/renewed passes.
files.data_impact: Creates only synthetic QA users, courses, sessions, registrations, subscriptions, credentials applications and engagement rows; test refuses all non-QA database URLs.
files.access_control_impact: Expired pass holders cannot reserve paid practice seats; existing free, purchased and institution enrollment rules remain unchanged.
risks: Adds a paid-enrollment source/subscription lookup to practice registration.
Previously reserved seats are preserved; this patch checks new requests and does not revoke existing reservations.
files.rollback: Revert this commit and rebuild academy. No database rollback needed; reverting reopens the expired-pass access flaw.

production_safety.operational_data: No production records changed by this patch or tests. Synthetic QA data only.
external_side_effects: 54 local HTTP checks with synthetic Auth.js sessions; no external payments or mail. Existing AWS d742828 build completed separately without switching services.

verification.evidence: 54 checks passed. Regression first reproduced an expired pass receiving HTTP 201 instead of 403; after fix expiration rejects with no registration, renewal returns 201. Evidence output/qa-api-cross-evidence.json.

residual_risks: New academy production image must be built before rollout; previously built d742828 images do not contain this patch.
Existing reservations made before expiry are preserved; attendance policy after expiry is outside this change.
Live PG approval/refund and actual video playback are not exercised by this test.
Remaining goal work includes deployment, production smoke verification, broader feature gaps and final report.
